Stephane Robert Lemieux is a Visiting Professor with the Canadian Centre for Welding and Joining (CCWJ) from MacEwan University. His research focuses on the collision resistance properties of medieval mail, with the goal of refining and improving the understanding of medieval archery efficacy for both the academic community and the general public. His work combines historical research with engineering principles to investigate the performance of historical protective equipment.

Outside of research, Stephane enjoys warbow archery, hunting, and historical reenactment.

##### Prior Degrees

PhD, University of Alberta, 2004  
MSc, Carleton University, 1999  
BSc, Carleton University, 1997

##### Selected Achievements

Four patented cryptographic algorithms  
Research Award from the Federal Deputy Minister of Agriculture  
Associate of the Canadian Institute of Actuaries (CIA)
